take: Kaynes Technology continues to deliver top-line revenue expansion driven by its EMS and overseas acquisitions, but cash generation remains severely pressured. Operating cash flow is deeply negative as working capital intensity mounts, driven by ballooning debtor days and inventory build-up.

promises.promise: Expecting net working capital days between 70 to 85 days.
promises.delivered: Working capital days reached 193 days by March 2026.

promises.promise: Targeting full year revenue of INR450 to INR500 crores between OSAT and PCB.
promises.delivered: Too early to judge full-year outcome.

promises.promise: Rail business to grow by around 20% to 25% this year.
promises.delivered: Too early to judge full-year outcome.

promises.promise: Do a PCB revenue of around INR300 crores to INR400 crores.
promises.delivered: Too early to judge full-year outcome.

promises.promise: Do an OSAT revenue of around INR250 crores to INR300 crores.
promises.delivered: Too early to judge full-year outcome.

narrative.claim: Management states the core EMS business generates positive cash flow and solid underlying momentum.
narrative.numbers: Operating cash flow for FY26 was negative INR600 crores and cash conversion cycle worsened to 193 days.

narrative.claim: Management highlights broad-based segment expansion across automotive, industrial, and railway verticals.
narrative.numbers: Consolidated revenue grew by 40.6% YoY to INR946 crores in Jun 2026.

narrative.claim: Management notes smart metering headwinds are temporary and will normalize.
narrative.numbers: Smart metering business saw flat to negative growth of minus 12% in Q1 FY27.

guidance.latest: INR450 to INR500 crores full year revenue
Outgrow the market and double the market growth rate

bull.point: Consolidated revenue scaled strongly to INR3,626 crores in FY26, supported by robust growth across EMS and international acquisitions.
Commercial production for OSAT has officially commenced with sample shipments dispatched to three prominent global clients.
Large cumulative order book of INR83,663 million provides visible medium-term revenue support.

bear.point: Operating cash flow turned deeply negative to INR600 crores in FY26 due to extreme working capital intensity and collection lags.
Debtor days blew out significantly from 77 days in FY25 to 154 days in FY26, straining liquidity.
Smart metering business continues to experience negative growth and collection bottlenecks due to ground execution delays.
